date.quote: An assessment order dated 29.12.2023 for the assessment period 2017-18 is the subject of challenge.

events.quote: An audit was conducted in August 2023 by the Assistant Commissioner (ST), Mettur Circle.
Upon receipt of audit observations, the petitioner replied thereto in September 2023.
Eventually, an audit report was issued in December 2023.
Subsequent thereto, a show cause notice was issued by the second respondent on 23.12.2023 calling upon the petitioner to reply on or before 27.12.2023.
The petitioner replied on 26.12.2023 and stated that the relevant records were produced before the audit officer at the time of audit.
In those circumstances, the impugned assessment order was issued on 29.12.2023.

document_contents.quote: The petitioner replied on 26.12.2023 and stated that the relevant records were produced before the audit officer at the time of audit.
It was further stated therein that the relevant documents are being submitted at the Commercial Tax Department, Mettur Assessment Circle.
By referring to the impugned assessment order, she points out that the assessing officer concluded that the petitioner had not produced any documents or records.

defects_argued.quote: On examining the show cause notice, it is evident that insufficient time was provided in as much as such notice is dated 23.12.2023 and the petitioner was only given about four days to respond thereto.
In those circumstances, the findings recorded in the impugned assessment order that no documents were produced cannot be sustained.

outcome.quote: Therefore, the impugned assessment order dated 29.12.2023 is quashed and the matter is remanded for re-consideration.
